extra_vocab.en: a collection of work that shows what a person has done
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，portfolio 是參加者要帶的作品資料，整理自己做過的重要專案，讓主辦單位據此配對導師。語感偏專業，不是單純的履歷。

example.en: Applicants brought portfolios showing their best projects to the interview.
example.zh: 應徵者帶著展示最佳專案的作品集來面試。

example.en: Designers build a portfolio to show clients their skills.
example.zh: 設計師會累積作品集，向客戶展示自己的能力。

example.en: Her investment portfolio grew by eight percent last year.
example.zh: 她的投資組合去年成長了百分之八。

example.en: The merger will widen the company's product portfolio significantly.
example.zh: 這次合併將大幅擴大公司的產品組合。

example.en: A portfolio review is part of the interview process.
example.zh: 作品集審查是面試流程的一部分。

examples.en: The interviewer asked to see my portfolio of recent work.
examples.zh: 面試官要求看我近期作品的作品集。

examples.en: Please attach a portfolio when you apply for the design job.
examples.zh: 申請這份設計工作時，請附上作品集。

examples.en: The bank offers advice on how to manage your portfolio.
examples.zh: 銀行提供如何管理投資組合的建議。

confusable.diff: resume 是用文字列出學經歷的履歷；portfolio 是展示實際作品與成果的資料。

example.en: Please send your resume and a portfolio of recent projects.
example.zh: 請寄來你的履歷和近期專案的作品集。

confusable.diff: profile 是簡短的個人或公司簡介；portfolio 是實際作品的集合。

example.en: Update your online profile before the recruiter calls you.
example.zh: 在招募人員打給你之前，先更新你的線上簡介。

example.en: She led three major projects during her first two years.
example.zh: 她在頭兩年主導了三個重要專案。

example.en: The workshop focuses on career development for new managers.
example.zh: 這場工作坊著重新任經理的職涯發展。

example.en: Candidates need at least three years of sales experience.
example.zh: 應徵者需要至少三年的業務經驗。

senses.en: a collection of a person's work or projects

example.en: Applicants should bring a portfolio of their best designs.
example.zh: 應徵者應帶上他們最佳設計的作品集。

senses.en: all the investments that a person or company owns
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 investment、stock，談的是金錢與資產。

example.en: The fund manager updated the client's investment portfolio.
example.zh: 基金經理人更新了客戶的投資組合。

senses.en: all the products or services a company offers
senses.distinguish: 前面常有 product、service，指公司的整體產品線。

example.en: Our product portfolio now includes three new office chairs.
example.zh: 我們的產品組合現在多了三款新辦公椅。

extra_vocab.en: a large room where many people sit to watch a talk or show
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，auditorium 是舉辦工作坊的場地，因為座位有限，所以要先報名。公告中常用來指公司或學校裡的大型活動空間。

example.en: Both auditoriums were booked for the annual training day.
example.zh: 兩間禮堂都已被預約作年度訓練日使用。

example.en: The university's auditoria are used for lectures and company events.
example.zh: 這所大學的各禮堂用於演講和公司活動。

example.en: The awards ceremony will be held in the school auditorium.
example.zh: 頒獎典禮將在學校禮堂舉行。

example.en: Auditorium seating is limited to two hundred people per session.
example.zh: 禮堂座位每場限兩百人。

example.en: More than five hundred guests filled the auditorium for the launch.
example.zh: 超過五百位賓客坐滿禮堂參加發表會。

example.en: Registration opens in the main auditorium at nine.
example.zh: 報到九點在主禮堂開始。

examples.en: The product launch will take place in the company auditorium.
examples.zh: 新產品發表會將在公司禮堂舉行。

examples.en: All trainees should gather in the auditorium by nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 所有學員請在九點前到禮堂集合。

examples.en: The auditorium has a large screen and a modern sound system.
examples.zh: 這間禮堂有大螢幕和現代化的音響系統。

confusable.diff: 拼法開頭相近，但 auditor 是稽核員或查帳人員，auditorium 是禮堂。

example.en: The auditor will review our accounts next month.
example.zh: 稽核員下個月會審查我們的帳目。

confusable.diff: audience 是「聽眾」（人）；auditorium 是聽眾坐的「禮堂」（地方）。

example.en: The audience listened carefully during the whole presentation.
example.zh: 聽眾在整場簡報中都專心聆聽。

similar.diff: hall 泛指大廳或大型空間，常見 conference hall；auditorium 特指有舞台與固定座位的禮堂。

example.en: The conference hall holds about three hundred people.
example.zh: 這間會議廳可容納約三百人。

similar.diff: lecture hall 是階梯式的講堂，多用在學校；auditorium 更常用在公司或活動。

example.en: The lecture hall has seats for two hundred students.
example.zh: 這間階梯講堂有兩百個學生座位。

example.en: The speaker walked onto the stage and greeted everyone.
example.zh: 講者走上舞台向大家問好。

example.en: Seating is limited, so please register early.
example.zh: 座位有限，請提早報名。

example.en: The venue for the annual meeting has not been chosen yet.
example.zh: 年會的場地還沒決定。

extra_vocab.en: to change the design or structure of a room or building
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，remodeled 用被動語態說明禮堂去年春天已改建完成，用來補充場地的資訊。remodel 側重改變格局或外觀，不只是修理。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: remodel 是及物動詞，後面直接接地點或建築物；被動寫成 was remodeled。美式拼 remodeled，英式拼 remodelled。

example.en: The landlord remodels the office floors every few years.
example.zh: 房東每隔幾年就會改建辦公室樓層。

example.en: The hotel remodeled its lobby before the tourist season began.
example.zh: 飯店在旅遊旺季開始前改建了大廳。

example.en: The bank remodelled its London branch to add meeting rooms.
example.zh: 這家銀行改建了倫敦分行，增設會議室。

example.en: Remodeling the lobby will begin right after the holiday.
example.zh: 大廳的改建將在假期結束後立刻開始。

example.en: They decided to remodel the break room this summer.
example.zh: 他們決定今年夏天改建休息室。

example.en: The newly remodeled lobby has a modern reception desk.
example.zh: 新近改建的大廳有一張現代化的接待櫃檯。

example.en: The remodeling project will be finished by the end of May.
example.zh: 改建工程將在五月底前完成。

examples.en: We will remodel the second floor to create more meeting rooms.
examples.zh: 我們會改建二樓，增加更多會議室。

examples.en: The owner remodeled the building before leasing it to tenants.
examples.zh: 屋主在把大樓出租給房客之前先做了改建。

examples.en: The remodeling budget was approved by the board last week.
examples.zh: 改建預算上週已獲董事會核准。

similar.diff: renovate 強調把舊的修復、翻新，使它煥然一新；remodel 強調改變格局或樣式。

example.en: The firm will renovate the old warehouse into offices.
example.zh: 這家公司將把舊倉庫翻新成辦公室。

similar.diff: rebuild 是拆掉重建或重新建造；remodel 是在原有的建築上改造。

example.en: They had to rebuild the entire wall after the flood.
example.zh: 水災後，他們必須重建整面牆。

example.en: Construction on the new wing begins early next month.
example.zh: 新側翼大樓的施工將在下個月初開始。

example.en: The contractor promised to finish the work before the holidays.
example.zh: 承包商承諾在假期前完工。

example.en: The new design makes better use of the available space.
example.zh: 新設計能更有效運用現有空間。

derived.link: remodel 是 re-（重新）+ model（造型、樣式），重新塑造成新的樣子，像 rewrite

example.en: The company plans to remodel the lobby next spring.
example.zh: 公司計畫明年春天改建大廳。

example.en: The office remodel took about six weeks to finish.
example.zh: 辦公室的改建工程花了約六週完成。

extra_vocab.en: numbers that show facts about a group of people or things
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，Statistics 指去年課程的統計數據，用數字說明參加工作坊的員工晉升機會更高。這裡當複數使用，語氣客觀、有說服力。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 指「統計數據」時是複數，動詞用複數（statistics show）；指「統計學」這門學科時當單數（Statistics is …）。一項數字用單數 statistic。

example.en: One statistic in the report surprised the whole sales team.
example.zh: 報告中有一項統計數字讓整個業務團隊吃了一驚。

example.en: Recent statistics show that customer complaints have dropped.
example.zh: 最近的統計數據顯示，客訴已經減少。

example.en: According to official statistics, the market grew by five percent.
example.zh: 根據官方統計數據，市場成長了百分之五。

example.en: Please send me the latest sales statistics by noon.
example.zh: 請在中午前把最新的銷售統計寄給我。

example.en: We collect statistics on website visits every week.
example.zh: 我們每週蒐集網站訪客的統計數據。

examples.en: The annual report includes statistics on employee satisfaction and turnover.
examples.zh: 年度報告包含員工滿意度與離職率的統計數據。

examples.en: The manager used statistics to support her proposal.
examples.zh: 經理用統計數據來支持她的提案。

examples.en: Statistics from the survey helped us choose the best advertising channel.
examples.zh: 問卷調查的統計數據幫助我們選出最好的廣告管道。

similar.diff: figures 較口語，泛指數字、金額；statistics 指經過整理分析的統計資料。

example.en: The latest sales figures for the quarter look very encouraging.
example.zh: 本季最新的銷售數字看起來非常令人振奮。

similar.diff: data 是原始資料；statistics 是把資料整理分析後得出的統計結果。

example.en: We need more data before making a final decision.
example.zh: 做最後決定前，我們需要更多資料。

example.en: We need more data before we make a final decision.
example.zh: 做最後決定前，我們需要更多資料。

example.en: The survey asked customers how they use the product.
example.zh: 這份問卷詢問客戶如何使用這項產品。

example.en: A large percentage of staff chose to attend the workshop.
example.zh: 很大比例的員工選擇參加工作坊。

senses.en: numbers that show facts about people or things
senses.distinguish: 當複數用，後面接複數動詞，如 statistics show。

example.en: Sales statistics show that online orders are rising quickly.
example.zh: 銷售統計數據顯示網路訂單快速增加。

senses.en: the study of collecting and analyzing numbers
senses.distinguish: 指這門學科時當單數，如 Statistics is a useful subject。

example.en: She studied statistics before joining the research department.
example.zh: 她在加入研究部門前學過統計學。

extra_vocab.en: an experienced person who helps and advises a less experienced person
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡，mentor 是公司為參加者配對的導師，會依各人的經驗提供職涯建議。管理職培訓與新人訓練常見這個字。

forms.label: 名詞複數／動詞第三人稱單數

example.en: Several mentors attended the workshop to meet their new partners.
example.zh: 幾位導師出席工作坊，與他們的新夥伴見面。

example.en: She mentored three junior analysts during her first year as manager.
example.zh: 她擔任經理的第一年指導了三位初階分析師。

example.en: Mentoring younger staff has improved our team's retention rate.
example.zh: 指導年輕員工提高了我們團隊的留任率。

example.en: HR will assign a mentor to every new employee.
example.zh: 人資部會為每位新進員工指派一位導師。

example.en: He agreed to serve as a mentor for young engineers.
example.zh: 他同意擔任年輕工程師的導師。

example.en: The mentor program helps new hires adjust to their roles.
example.zh: 導師計畫幫助新進員工適應他們的角色。

examples.en: My mentor gave me useful advice about moving into management.
examples.zh: 我的導師給了我關於轉任管理職的實用建議。

examples.en: Your mentor will meet with you once a month.
examples.zh: 你的導師每個月會和你見一次面。

examples.en: Having a good mentor can speed up your career growth.
examples.zh: 有一位好導師能加快你的職涯成長。

confusable.diff: 拼法有點像，但 monitor 是「監看、追蹤」，mentor 是「指導、提供建議」。

example.en: The supervisor will monitor sales while the mentor gives career advice.
example.zh: 主管會追蹤銷售狀況，而導師會提供職涯建議。

similar.diff: coach 偏重指導具體技能；mentor 偏重長期的職涯經驗傳承。

example.en: The company hired a coach to improve our presentation skills.
example.zh: 公司聘請了一位教練來提升我們的簡報技巧。

similar.diff: adviser 提供專業建議，不一定長期陪伴；mentor 通常有持續的指導關係。

example.en: The financial adviser suggested a safer investment plan.
example.zh: 財務顧問建議了一個較穩健的投資方案。

example.en: Each trainee receives a workbook on the first day.
example.zh: 每位受訓者在第一天都會拿到一本練習手冊。

example.en: Please report any problems to your supervisor right away.
example.zh: 如有任何問題，請立刻向你的主管回報。

example.en: A colleague from the finance team joined our meeting.
example.zh: 財務團隊的一位同事加入了我們的會議。

example.en: Each new manager will be given an experienced mentor.
example.zh: 每位新任經理都會被分配一位經驗豐富的導師。

example.en: She mentors new employees in the sales department.
example.zh: 她在業務部門指導新進員工。
